name: The McBean household at 2017 Prairie Avenue
head: pa1904_mcbean_a_j

present_on_scene_date.note: Listed at 2017 Prairie Avenue in the Blue Book for 1904 (canvass begun September 1903) and again in the 1905 edition (canvass begun September 1904), which bracket 1 July 1904. The 1905 list prints: 2017 Mr. & Mrs. A. J. McBean; George B. McBean; Mr. & Mrs. A. J. F. McBean.

associated_with.note: The Blue Book's Prairie Avenue street list prints the household at 2017, and the 1905 list again. The book gives no date the household came or went, so neither end is dated here.

not_in_this_household.note: WHO IS NOT ON THIS CARD, AND WHY. The Blue Book is a society register: it names the family members who received and were received, prints unmarried daughters only as '& dr.', and names no young children, servants, coachmen, cooks or nurses. The 1900 census (ED 40, T623 roll 245) was read for this card. The four live-in staff it lists at the house on 1 June 1900 are on the card, graded inferred because the count was taken four years before the scene. The 1910 census was not read. A person goes on this card when a source names them, and not before.

persons.name: A. J. McBean
persons.note: The 1900 census lists A. McBean here as head, born May 1835, in Scotland, came to the United States in 1850, married, cement mfr. (ED 40, sheet 12B, line 51, leaf n817).

persons.name: Mrs. A. J. McBean
persons.note: The 1900 census lists Georgina McBean here as wife, born January 1852, in Scotland, married (ED 40, sheet 12B, line 52, leaf n817).

persons.name: George B. McBean
persons.note: Listed at 2017 in both editions; his relation to A. J. McBean is not printed. The 1900 census lists George McBean here as son, born April 1876, in Illinois, single (ED 40, sheet 12B, line 55, leaf n817).

persons.name: A. J. F. McBean
persons.printed_as: 2017 Mr. & Mrs. A. J. F. McBean
persons.note: A second McBean couple listed at 2017 in both editions; the relation to the first is not printed. The 1900 census lists A. McBean Jr. here as son, born February 1870, in Illinois, married, lawyer (ED 40, sheet 12B, line 53, leaf n817).

persons.name: Mrs. A. J. F. McBean
persons.printed_as: 2017 Mr. & Mrs. A. J. F. McBean
persons.note: Listed with A. J. F. McBean; see his note. The 1900 census lists Almira McBean here as daughter-in-law, born March 1869, in Illinois, married (ED 40, sheet 12B, line 54, leaf n817).

persons.name: Bertha Parson

born.note: The census gives February 1871, age 29 on 1 June 1900.

persons.note: Enumerated on 1 June 1900 in the house, as a servant; born February 1871 (the figures are hard to read), in Sweden, single. Servants changed places often, so this records who worked here in 1900; no source read says whether this person was still here on 1 July 1904. Part of the name is hard to read on the sheet; this is the best reading.
